title: System
description: The system's own primitives, stored in the same map so it describes itself.

types.title: Source
types.description: The original input a fact came from: a file, an email, a commit, a conversation.

uri.description: A stable address: a file path, URL or message id.

types.title: Connection
types.description: An external tool, such as an MCP server. Status says whether it is reachable right now.

audit_log.description: Path to a JSON-lines log of tool calls, read by import_audit.

types.title: Run
types.description: One agent session or one execution of an automation.

branch.description: The git branch the session said it works on: a push to it is read against the session's task.

session_id.description: The id the surface gave the session.

last_seen.description: Last time the session reported in.

stale_flagged.description: Set once the human has been told this session went quiet.

started_by.description: Who started the run, when it was not the owner: { kind: person, automation or webhook, id, name }. Such a run only proposes: its changes wait for the owner, whatever agents may do here.

tokens_used.description: Tokens the session has used so far, as its machine counted them.

active.description: When the session was at work: stretches from a turn's start to its end, as [from, to] date-times, oldest first.

busy.description: Set while a turn is under way: begun and not yet ended.

story.description: The story the session tells of its work, beat by beat (the tell tool).

cost_usd.description: What the run cost, in US dollars, where its surface says.

turns.description: How many turns the run took.

link.description: Where the run can be looked at, e.g. its page in GitHub Actions.

types.title: Notification
types.description: A message for the human, from an agent, an automation or the system.

types.title: Automation
types.description: A trigger that fires an action. Only fires while its status is enabled.

trigger.description: every: an interval. daily: a time of day. event: something logged in the activity feed.

at.description: For trigger daily: local time as HH:MM.

on_action.description: For trigger event: an event action such as proposal.create, or a prefix such as resource.*

action.description: notify: tell the human. tool: call check_connections or import_audit. launch: start a headless session on a task.

message.description: For action notify. May use {target}, {action}, {actor} and {reason} from the triggering event.

input.description: For action tool: the tool's input. For action launch: {task, mode, instructions}.

last_run.description: The run the last launch started.

types.title: Shared document
types.description: A document another workspace on this server shares with this one. It stays in that workspace's map and is read from there each time, while it is shared: set it to accepted to read it here, declined or ended to stop. Only the document and the items it brings in are read. Where that workspace allows it, it can be published here, frozen as that workspace gives it.

share.description: The share it is read through, in that workspace.

path.description: Its address word once published here, as a document's: published only where the workspace that shares it allows it.

menu.description: Its place in the site's header, lowest first, as a document's.

links.title: is working on
links.description: What a run or actor is doing right now.

rules.say: An automation acts later on the authority of the human who approved it: making, changing or bringing one back is theirs.
